title: Operation Condor: Cable from FBI Attaché Robert Scherrer to Amb. George Landau
publisher_or_archive: National Security Archive / FBI Declassified Files
summary: Historic declassified FBI intelligence cable dated September 28, 1976, providing the first US government confirmation of Operation Condor's existence, structure, and operational code name, outlining how intelligence services of the Southern Cone established joint hit teams ('Phase III') to liquidate exile leaders across Europe and the Americas.
